interface.shortDescription: Transcribe public media and analyze transcripts.
interface.longDescription: Connect Video Transcriber AI with your own API Key, transcribe public media, and analyze transcripts or subtitles. Transcription consumes independent API Quota. Existing text analysis requires no API Key.
defaultPrompt: Help me connect Video Transcriber AI and check the connection without creating a transcription.
Transcribe this public media URL and return the transcript and subtitles.
Summarize this transcript and extract action items.
